title: Mission Control AI loop UI: conditional adaptive operations view for run_mode=ai_loop only — existing Scan Map/Tasks/AI Signal layout unchanged for all other runs
goal: When a run has run_mode=ai_loop, Mission Control switches to the adaptive operations view. For all other run modes (manual, fixed-chain), the existing Scan Map/Tasks/AI Signal layout renders unchanged. The gate condition is: if (selectedRun.run_mode === 'ai_loop') render AI loop view else render existing view. AI LOOP VIEW layout: TOP STATUS BAR: 'AI Assessment · Iteration 5 of 20 · [target] · Tier: Active · Runtime: 12m'. Four panels: (1) LEFT — Current Action: tool name, specific target URL/host, progress indicator, estimated time. No emoji — use existing icon set (spinner, tool icon, target icon). (2) CENTRE — What We Know: growing list of confirmed signals and findings, each timestamped with iteration number and evidence ref. Items have confidence indicator. Text uses professional ROE-aware language: not 'admin cookie extracted' but 'session token exposure risk confirmed (canary evidence, iteration 3)'. Critical/High findings highlighted. (3) RIGHT — AI Reasoning: current decision text from AgentReasoning.thought_text, next planned action. Always tied to specific evidence refs: 'Based on: [finding-id-123] file-upload-endpoint + [finding-id-124] reflected-xss'. (4) BOTTOM — Iteration Timeline: horizontal timeline, one node per iteration, shows tool used and key finding at each node. Click node to expand evidence. TIER ESCALATION OVERLAY (full-width, blocks interaction): appears when AI wants to escalate tier. Shows: tool, specific target, AI reasoning text (from reasoning record), risk tier badge, estimated time. Three buttons: [Approve and continue loop] [Skip this step, continue] [Stop assessment]. All copy uses tier-appropriate language: active tier says 'controlled active scan', intrusive says 'intrusive test — requires explicit authorization'. KILL SWITCH: 'Stop Assessment' button always visible in top-right. Stops loop immediately, marks run completed_with_operator_stop. PREREQUISITE: run_mode field must exist on runs (from backlog-260). If field absent, fall back to existing layout.
scope: ChatGPT review 2026-05-06: Mission Control must not be globally replaced. Only runs with run_mode=ai_loop get the new UI. Existing Scan Map/Tasks/AI Signal stays for manual and fixed-chain runs. ROE-proof language required for all AI reasoning text visible to operators.
generation_reason: AI loop runs need an adaptive operations view. Manual and fixed-chain runs keep existing layout. run_mode gate controls the switch.

inputs.prerequisite_backlog: backlog-260 must be completed first — run_mode=ai_loop field and loop state API must exist before this UI can render correctly.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: ONLY renders when selectedRun.run_mode === 'ai_loop'. Must not change any rendering for manual or fixed-chain runs. Use existing project icon set — no emoji in UI.
constraints.roe_language: All AI reasoning text visible to operators must use tier-appropriate professional language. Active tier: 'controlled active scan evidence'. Intrusive: 'controlled proof under authorized intrusive scope'. Never 'exploit', 'hack', 'steal' in operator-facing copy unless explicitly under exploitation tier ROE.

success_criteria: Manual run: Mission Control renders existing Scan Map/Tasks/AI Signal layout unchanged.
Fixed-chain run: Mission Control renders existing layout unchanged.
ai_loop run: Mission Control renders adaptive operations view with all 4 panels.
Tier escalation overlay appears full-width only for ai_loop runs.
All copy uses professional ROE-aware language — no raw exploit terminology.
AI Reasoning text includes evidence refs (finding IDs or iteration refs), not free-floating claims.
Stop Assessment button always visible during ai_loop run.
No emoji in any UI component — use existing project icon system.
No regression in manual and fixed-chain Mission Control E2E tests.

acceptance_criteria: Manual run: existing layout unchanged (regression test).
ai_loop run: adaptive view renders with iteration counter.
Tier escalation overlay appears for ai_loop tier escalation.
All copy passes ROE language review.
No emoji visible in any UI component.

Emoji or decorative icons outside project icon system
